text: また　あそびに　きてね！

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb stem plus に before a going or coming verb tells what you come to do. あそびに　きて = 'come to play'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A て-form at the end is a friendly way to ask someone to do something, and ね makes it softer. きてね = 'come, okay?'.
